title: Some people were in church.
paragraphs: Some were one prayer away from giving up.

Not when you had it all together.
Not when you were perfect.
Right in the middle of the mess.
Because your story didn’t end where He found you.
That’s the moment He started redeeming you.
📖 “But God demonstrates His own love for us in this: while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.” — Romans 5:8

👇
Comment where God found you.
Your testimony might be the reason someone doesn’t give up today.
